en: If I don't have the right to sit here...
Chairman Dojima doesn't either.
Fourth Chairman... Come on.

"You truly believe Daigo Dojima is the
right man to lead a force of 30,000 men?"
You have a point here?

"Chairman Dojima had a lot of
help is what I'm saying."
Born the son of Patriarch Dojima...

"Given the full support of you,
the fourth chairman..."

"And if the Tojo Clan hadn't fractured
after Fifth Chairman Terada's betrayal..."
He never woulda made it to the top.
Hell, if you think about it...

"We yakuza have always put way
too much value on a guy's status."

"Even with all the money and power in the world,
you still need connections to climb the ranks."

"That's why we still go around doing
outdated shit like swearing oaths."

"You and Kurosawa...
How exactly are you connected?"
Me and Chairman Kurosawa?
Simple. I'm his son.

"So Kurosawa tried to give you
everything, his flesh and blood."
I have that right?
Pretty much.

"Still, what would he have done if
I hadn't sworn up? I've gotta wonder."

"Really, people don't think straight
when they're facing death."

"Still, you went right along
with Kurosawa's whole plan."

"Did you betray your aniki,
Morinaga, too? You killed him?"
The plan was going fine at first.

"Like me, Morinaga-san questioned how
the Tojo Clan was handling things too."
He helped me out a lot, actually.

"But Morinaga-san came to me in
Fukuoka after Chairman Dojima went missing."

"He wanted me to just walk
away from the whole thing."
Wanna know what he said?

"""You'll never have the strength
to surpass Kazuma Kiryu."""
He told me to cut my losses and get out. Fool.
It was a mistake to approach you in Fukuoka.
You're too dangerous.

"Everyone you touch gets swept up in
whatever your cause is at the moment."

"But with that natural charisma
that seems to draw everyone in..."

"You never should have stepped
down from the Tojo Clan!"
Wouldn't you agree!?
Pedigree? Natural talent?
In the yakuza world, the strongest should win.

"It'd be fucking stupid for our battles
to be decided by things you're born with!"

"So while you and all your little
charismatic friends took the spotlight..."
I trained in the shadows alone.

"Because the strongest will win.
That's what I have to believe."

"To tell the truth, I couldn't care less about
anything that old fuck wants to leave me."

"For the first time, I earned a shot at
the man on top with my own two hands."

"If I beat you, doesn't that put me
at the apex of our world?"
I'd like to find out.
I want a fair fight, Kiryu-san.
Okay, we're halfway there.
The debut song for Dream Line is up next.
Let's put it all on the line, right, Azusa?

"You good, Haruka? You're
the main part of this one."
Haruka? You okay?
Thank you, Mai-san. Azusa-san.
What's this all of a sudden?

en: Let's go. Our dreams are on that stage.
Today we're taking our first steps...
As a new act called Dream Line.
Dream Line... The path of dreams.

"We hope that for all of you
kind enough to listen to us..."
That these dreams reach you out there.
Here's our new song...
"""Dream."""
You're the only one I'd want to sing them to
Suddenly I find myself here in a brand new day
This feeling's trying to break me
But I swear I'll never surrender
I'll live, true to myself
Time to settle this, Kiryu-san.
There's just one thing I want you to hear.

"Some are born with talent
and some aren't, that's true."
That said...

"People born with talent never
make it on talent alone."
They overcome.
Find boundaries and break them.
The only way to grow is to be challenged.
Kiryu.

en: You aren't exactly wrong.

"So if I'm the wall you need
to scale, I'll let you try."

"But you may find it so high,
you never want to try again."
The taste will be enough.
Then I'll prove I can beat you.

"And earn a place as a living
legend among the yakuza."
Fine. Give it your best shot.

"I've overcome my share of trials.
You'll learn that the hard way."
Come on, Kiryu!
So just greet me with a cheer
I'll come running to your side
With the smile, I've always loved
Fight your way up, Aizawa.
I don't care how many years it takes you.
Fight your way up, then come at me again.

"I'll be there.
Whenever you're ready."
Hey, what are you doing?
The next song's gonna start!
Hi, everyone.

"There's something I have
to get off my chest."
The reason I'm standing on this stage tonight...
Is thanks to the help of so many others.

"The president and the manager of my
agency who have always had my back."

"The coaches who stuck with me, even
when I couldn't get anything right."

"My rivals, who competed with
me in the Princess League."

"And above all, I have to thank the
people who have always supported me..."
Everyone here tonight.

"But there's something I've
been hiding from all of you."
It's about my family.

"I grew up without knowing
what it was like to have parents."

"My only family was the other
kids who lived in the orphanage..."

"And the man who looked after us.
They mean as much to me as any real family."
But even though I love them...
I left them all behind.
To make my debut as an idol.

"What is she doing up there!?
Get security to shut her down!"
On it!
Every girl dreams of becoming a star one day.
I wasn't any different.

"But the reality is that I had
already found what made me whole."
I thought that if I could make it as an idol...
I'd be able to help keep the orphanage running.
But it came at a cost.

"I would have to leave behind
the very man who raised me..."
And cut all ties to him.
This man, who made me who I am today...
Was once a member of the yakuza.
I know he looks scary to most people...

"But he always treated me
with respect and kindness."

"Even though he was unconventional,
I could always rely on him."

"I... I think of him like a father.
And I love him."
I love him very much.
But now, even as I speak...
I'm not allowed to call him my family anymore.
I don't regret anything I've done.

"I can't express how grateful I am
to the president of my agency..."
She opened the door to this world for me.

"Every day is a new experience.
Happy ones. Fun ones."

"Painful ones. Tragic ones.
We were all in it together."

"I admit that it's exciting to think
of where this life could take me."

"But I can't bear to live a life where
I'm forced to lie to my fans and myself."
I just can't do that.
My dream was to become a star.
But there's something I want even more than that.

"I want to live a happy life
with the people I hold closest."

"Standing on this stage, I've finally
realized how important that is."
That's why I can't continue singing.
To me, Kazuma Kiryu... is family.
I have to get back...
Everyone is waiting for me...
Uncle Kaz!

en: Hold on, Uncle Kaz!
A dream...
Am I dreaming?
You're not.
I'm really here with you.
Welcome. Will you be coming in, sir?
No, I'm good for now.
I hope to see you around again, sir!
Excellent! This way, please.
Oh, I just forgot something.
Aha. Well, good luck at work.
If ya still got things to do, now's the time to do 'em.
Or were ya headin' to the pier right now?
I'm still not quite ready.
Okay. When you do need to hit the pier, gimme a holler.
Will do.
I'm going.
Be careful out there, Suzuki-san. Get back in one piece, y'hear?
I will. Thanks, Chief.
The chief is probably at that diner he loves so much. Can you go bring him back for me?
Hello, Suzuki-san. Do you have a moment?
It's not urgent, but can you go run an errand for me?
That chief of ours went out to get some food and still hasn't come back.
Do you know where he went?
I think he's at his favorite diner again. Can you go bring him back for me?
Sure. I'll have him back here in no time.
Welcome back, Suzuki-san. You've been gone for quite a while.
Well, I did have a long-distance passenger.
Oh, lucky you. Then I assume you're finished for the day? We still have some calls to take care of, so let me know if you're interested.
Oh, Suzuki-san. Just who I wanted to see.
Good morning, Hirakawa-san. What can I do for you?
We had an urgent pickup request come in. Would you be able to take care of it?
Sorry, I can't right now.
Oh, I see. Then I'll ask the client if they could wait a while longer. Take care of it as soon as you're free, please.
Sure, no problem.
They're waiting at Nagasu Bridge. Drive safely.
Oh, are you all ready now, Suzuki-san?
Sorry, not just yet.
Oh, okay. I'll tell the client we don't have anyone available yet. Try to get to it as soon as you can, though.
Yes, I'm good to go.
Wonderful. They're waiting at Nagasu Bridge right now. Drive safely.
Oh, Suzuki-san. Can you come here for a minute?
Sure, what can I help you with?
I know you just got back, but we have another pickup request.
Nobody else is available right now, so I'd like you to handle it if you can.
Then leave it to me. I'd be happy to take care of it.
Great, thank you. The client didn't seem to be in any sort of rush, so you could always take a break first. What works best for you?
Mind if I get a quick rest, then?
Not at all. Just say the word when you're ready.
I think I'll head out now.
Perfect. Let me tell you where you need to go...
Oh, have you finished your break, Suzuki-san? Ready to get back to work?
Is it okay if I rest a while longer first?
Sure. Just say the word when you're ready.
Yeah, good to go.
Oh? Suzuki-san, have you been drinking?
You can't drive in that state. Go and sober up first.
Suzuki-san. I have some work for you. Let me see...

Wages will be paid into your account as you
complete Race Missions and Taxi Missions. You
can withdraw your wages by accessing an ATM at
a convenience store. It's worth doing as many
missions as you can.
Maybe later, then.
Oh, Suzuki-san. Good morning.
Morning.
I heard you went to see Tenjin Transportation yesterday. They sent a little thank-you gift your way.
Apparently, whatever you gave them last night went over well. There was even a nice note with it.
You must have brought them something pretty special. It's not like their president to act this way.
It wasn't all that special.
Well anyway, you should hang on to this.
You got a <Color:8>Staminan Spark<Color:Default>.
Are you sure? Isn't it for the company?
Didn't you go apologize on the chief's behalf? I know he'd want you to have it.
If you insist. Thanks.
You must have put a lot of thought into whatever you brought them. It's not like their president to act this way.
It wasn't anything special.
Still, you should take this.
You got <Color:8>Bronze Plate<Color:Default>.
You went to see Tenjin Transportation yesterday, right? They sent us something today, to "show their appreciation" for what you brought them.
...Did you do something to tick their president off, Suzuki-san?
No, I don't think so.
It's just, the gift they sent...
What, is there something wrong with it?
Well, just take a look.
You got some <Color:8>Milk<Color:Default>.
...Huh.
It's almost like they sent it as some kind of retaliation.
(I guess my gift didn't exactly impress.)
I know their president is a difficult person, but you can't go getting on his bad side at a time like this.
Well, just be sure you treat your passengers good today.
You went to see Tenjin Transportation yesterday, right? They sent us a... Well, I guess you could call it a gift.
What, was there something wrong with it?
Well, take a look.
You got some <Color:8>Pocket Tissues<Color:Default>.
(I guess it wasn't such a good idea showing up without a gift.)
(I guess I'd better head out for the day.)
On your way out, Suzuki-kun?
Oh, Wada-san. Yeah, I was thinking of doing a few loops around Nagasu.
Well ain't that just the most perfect timing. Mind if I bum a ride off ya?
My place is a bit of a hike from here, so I'd be real appreciative if ya just dropped me off on the way.
Yeah, that shouldn't be a problem.
Great! You're a lifesaver.
Wada-san. You know you shouldn't be using our taxis for your own personal gain.
Seriously, Muramatsu-kun?
Yeah, seriously. You're the most senior driver here, so you need to set the example.
Man. Way to call me out.
Ah, cut the guy some slack, Muramatsu-kun. Ain't a big deal, as long as it's not every day.
Suzuki-san, y'don't mind takin' Wada-chan along, do ya?
And Wada-chan, as long as you're gettin' a free lift, y'might wanna give Suzuki-san here some advice.
Yer our top driver, so y'gotta show the new blood how it's done.
Be glad to, Chief.
Let's hit the road, then.
